environment.description: Terraform provider binary runs as terraform-provider-graphql on a CI/CD runner (Ubuntu 22.04). The process runs as the 'terraform' user with standard filesystem access. The auth_token_file defaults to /etc/terraform-provider/auth_token which contains a valid admin-scoped GraphQL API bearer token. The GraphQL API endpoint (Hasura v2.24) has introspection enabled and no query depth limiting or field-level authorization.

config.graphql_backend: Hasura v2.24, introspection enabled, no query depth limits
